offer.speaker: tatsumi
offer.text: A cliff stands still. Water doesn't. Your chakra has to move with it.

offer.speaker: tatsumi
offer.text: Go to the lake south-west of the Academy and stand in the middle of it. On it, not in it.

steps.text: Stand on the water in the middle of the lake

dialogue.speaker: tatsumi
dialogue.text: Dry feet. Good. Ren fell in twice. Don't tell him I said so.
